article.story: COOKEVILLE, Tenn. -- — De’Ante Green had 23 points in Tennessee Tech’s 117-70 victory against Blue Mountain Christian on Wednesday. Green added 12 rebounds for the Golden Eagles (1-1). Caleb Sanders added 12 points to go with 10 rebounds. Kamai Samuels also scored 12 points. Seck Zongo led the way for the Toppers with 19 points and nine rebounds. Terrence Marco added 16 points, six rebounds and three blocks. Jeremiah Hayes had nine points. Up next Tennessee Tech hosts Western Kentucky in its next matchup on Sunday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
